methodology.faithfulness: RAGAS evidence support using retrieved PDF text and SQL result rows.
methodology.factual_correctness: RAGAS F1 versus manually validated gold answer.
methodology.scope: Only backend cases with status=ok and a nonempty answer.
limitations: Failed backend cases remain in the backend evaluation and are not scored here.
Missing RAGAS scores are excluded from means; they are not zeros.
LLM judge scores may require human verification.
